item.title: Women sidelined
item.description: Despite growing political engagement, women remain vastly underrepresented in Bangladesh's upcoming parliamentary elections. Of 2,569 candidates across 300 seats, only 108 are women-just 4.26 percent-and more than one-third are independents, reflecting strong ambition but limited opportunities within major parties ahead of 13th national polls. item.description: Brace for a bitter January. item.title: Venezuela court orders VP to temporarily assume presidency

item.title: Habiganj student leader Mahadi granted bail
item.description: Mahdi Hasan, member secretary of Students Against Discrimination in Habiganj, was granted bail on Sunday morning, after around 14 hours' of detention.Mahadi was shown arrested on Saturday night on charge of obstructing police to perform their duties.Meanwhile, leaders and activists of the SAD staged protests on the court premises, demanding his release. Strict security has been beefed up in and around the court.
